Archive clerk: Margrethe's letting you into the vault?
Then take Kul. He lived in the spire chimney.
c9.bs.clerk.gift.2:
Archive clerk: He came down through the fire
without a scratch. Steel doesn't scare him.
c9.bs.clerk.party: Kul huffed a smoke ring and joined your team.
c9.bs.clerk.box:
Your team is full, so Kul went to the PC.
You can swap him in at the Pokémon Center.
c9.bs.clerk.after:
Archive clerk: Keep Kul warm. He hates drafts.
The 1600s are very draughty.
c9.bs.mover:
Mover: I just lift boxes, mate.
Though these ones are very heavy for "misc."
c9.bs.law1.intro:
Vanguard Lawyer Petersen: This is a
private archiving operation!
c9.bs.law2.intro:
Vanguard Lawyer Gram: You'll want to speak
to my client. My client is three Pokémon.
c9.g7.guide.1:
Gym guide: Down here the old merchants
settled their accounts on the brass scales.
c9.g7.guide.2:
Guide: Win each merchant's token, then make
the scales balance. Read the ledgers on the walls.
c9.g7.guide.after:
Guide: Steel bends to no one, they say.
Except, apparently, to you.
c9.g7.gate:
The vault gate. It opens when the scales
below are in balance.
c9.g7.ledger.1:
A wall ledger: "A ship's share is five marks.
Salt, four. Spice, the dearest, seven."
c9.g7.ledger.2:
A wall ledger: "Twelve marks lie in the left
pan. Balance it with two tokens, no more."
c9.g7.m0.intro:
Merchant Ole: My token is a ship.
You'll have to sail through me first.
c9.g7.m1.intro:
Merchant Karen: Spice is worth its weight
in gold. My Pokémon are worth more.
c9.g7.m2.intro:
Merchant Niels: Salt keeps everything.
Including grudges. Battle!
c9.g7.m2.lose: Niels: No hard feelings. Well. A pinch.
c9.scales.1:
The great brass scales. Twelve marks of iron
sit in the left pan. The right pan is empty.
c9.scales.need:
You have {n} of the three merchants'
tokens. Win the rest first.
c9.scales.ask: Which tokens go in the right pan?
c9.scales.wrong:
The scales lurch and the tokens slide back
into your hands. Not balanced.
c9.scales.right:
The pans settle, perfectly level. Somewhere
above, a heavy gate rolls open.
c9.mar.gym.1:
Margrethe: You made it. Good. Rules exist
so that the right people can pass them.
c9.mar.gym.2:
Margrethe: The ledger is behind me. First,
show me you can carry what's in it.
c9.mar.gym.win: Margrethe: Not yet. Come back sharper.
c9.mar.shield:
Margrethe: Take this too. A storm shield
for your bike. You'll need it before the end.
c9.mar.ledger.1:
Margrethe: And this. The second ledger.
Andersen's hand again. Read the last page.
c9.mar.ledger.2:
"If the Voice is ever taken, the sea will rise
in grief."
c9.mar.ledger.3:
"Then wake the Sleeper beneath Kronborg,
and sing the old song at the highest fire."
c9.mar.ledger.4:
Margrethe: Kronborg. Helsingør. The Sleeper.
I'll stall the lawyers. You go and read it again.
c9.mar.gym.after:
Margrethe: Mind the ledger. It's older
than this building. Older than the spire was.
c9.kb.lukas.1:
Lukas: There you are. Margrethe? Ledger?
Good. Then I need something from you.
c9.kb.lukas.2:
Lukas: I quit Vanguard. I'm on your side.
Fine. But I need to know I'm strong enough.
c9.kb.lukas.3:
Lukas: Not for a scholarship. For whatever
is coming. Full strength. Both of us.
c9.kb.lukas.win:
Lukas: Huh. I'm stronger than I thought.
Don't let it go to your head. Mine, I mean.
c9.kb.lukas.4:
Lukas: I'm going to see Bosun Ivar. Grandad
built that shipyard. I want to know why.
c9.kb.lukas.5:
Lukas: Kronborg can wait a day.
...Thanks. For the fight. For all of it.
c9.end:
Your save is kept. The story continues in
Chapter 10: The Shipyards.
c10.start.1:
A message from Maja: "Lukas is at Refshaleøen
with Ivar. Bodil's bus still runs from Nyhavn."
c10.start.2:
"Brix sent me one line: 'Shipyards. Come.'
Brix! Watch yourself. Could be a trap."
c10.gate.early:
The yard gate is chained shut.
A sign: "B&W Shipyard. Closed since 1996."
c10.sy.arrive:
The old B&W shipyard. Rust, containers,
and the great crane against the sky.
c10.sy.lukas.1:
Lukas: You came. Ivar's been telling me
about Grandad. He built that crane.
c10.sy.ivar.1:
Ivar: Best welder on the Sound. When the yard
shut, he never set foot on Refshaleøen again.
c10.sy.lukas.2:
Lukas: Vanguard bought the yard for a song.
Mum says that's "stability". Funny word.
c10.sy.lukas.3:
Lukas: I'll be at the top of the crane.
Come up when you're ready. Bring everything.
c10.sy.ivar.2:
Ivar: Boy's got his grandad's jaw.
Come see me if you need patching up.
c10.sy.respawn:
Ivar: Easy now. Sit by the brazier.
The yard's not going anywhere.
c10.sy.ivar.heal:
Ivar: Kettle's on. Let's have a look
at that team of yours.
c10.sy.ivar.after:
Ivar: He came down that crane grinning.
His grandad would've cried. Here, rest.
c10.sy.sign:
B&W SHIPYARD. Slipway 4.
Hard hats past this point.
c10.sy.east.early:
Ivar's voice carries across the yard:
"Lukas is up the crane, waiting for you!"
c10.sy.t1.intro:
Ace Trainer: Victory Road, they call it now.
Let's see you earn the name.
c10.sy.t1.lose: Ace Trainer: Fair. You'll need that at CopenHill.
c10.sy.t2.intro:
Ace Trainer: Eight badges is a long way.
Seven is close enough to sting.
c10.sy.t2.lose: Ace Trainer: Stung. Go on, then.
c10.sy.t3.intro:
Shipwright: I riveted hulls here for thirty years.
I can still knock a dent out of you.
c10.sy.t3.lose: Shipwright: Dented. Ha! Good steel, you.
c10.sy.t4.intro:
Ace Trainer: The east quay's mine.
Toll's one battle.
c10.sy.t4.lose:
Ace Trainer: Toll paid. Mind the Enforcers
sniffing round the slipway.
c10.sy.t5.intro:
Ace Trainer: I've beaten everyone on this yard.
Everyone except whoever's up that crane.
c10.sy.t5.lose: Ace Trainer: And now you. Great.
c10.crane.west:
A dock crane with a rope seat.
It swings out over the slipway.
c10.crane.east:
The dock crane can swing you
back over the slipway.
c10.brix.1:
Dr. Brix: You! Good. Those two have been
following me since the reactor. Help me.
c10.brix.2:
Brix: I'll take the left one.
Try not to look surprised.
c10.brix.3:
Brix: ...I built the siphon. I told myself
it was only a pump. Then I heard the data.
c10.brix.4:
Brix: The storage cells... they're full.
They shouldn't be that full. Not ever.
c10.brix.5:
Brix: Here. The reactor shutdown sequence.
It needs a voice to close the circuit. Literally.
c10.brix.6:
Brix: Ørsted won't want to see me.
Tell him he was right. He'll like that.
c10.brix.7:
Brix: I'm going somewhere with no screens.
Good luck, child. Truly.
c10.gc.locked:
The great crane's lift. Enforcers are
patrolling the east quay. Not now.
c10.gc.up:
You ride the cage up the great crane.
The harbour drops away beneath you.
c10.ct.plate:
A brass plate on the rail:
"Welded by H. Lund and crew, 1974."
c10.ct.down: You ride the cage back down.
c10.ct.lukas.1:
Lukas: H. Lund. That's Grandad.
You can see the whole city from up here.
c10.ct.lukas.2:
Lukas: CopenHill next. Then Lindholm.
I won't let you go up there alone.
c10.ct.lukas.3:
Lukas: So I need to know you can take
everything he throws. Everything I've got first.
c10.ct.wait:
Lukas: Take your time.
I've got the best view in Hafnia.
c10.ct.lukas.4:
Lukas: ...Yeah. You're ready.
More than me, maybe.
c10.ct.lukas.5:
Lukas: I'll hold the slope when it comes
to it. Nobody gets past me to you.
c10.ct.lukas.6:
Lukas: Go get that last badge. Astrid's at
the plant. She's... not like the others.
c10.ct.after:
Lukas: Go on. I'll catch up.
I want five more minutes with the view.
c10.ch.arrive:
CopenHill. A power plant with a ski slope
on its roof, and smoke rings from the stack.
c10.ch.sign:
AMAGER BAKKE. Waste to energy.
Ski slope open all year!
c10.ch.lift:
The summit lift. Its cables are dead.
A Vanguard notice: "Grid maintenance."
c10.ch.skier:
Skier: Ski slope's grand, but the lift's off.
Walking up in boots is a workout.
c10.ch.worker:
Plant worker: The Chief's in the turbine hall.
She hasn't slept in a week, I reckon.
c10.g8.guide.1:
Guide: Astrid's at the top, past the lift gate.
The gate opens when the summit lift has power.
c10.g8.guide.2:
Guide: Read the board by the door.
Three turbines, three relays. Mind number 2.
c10.g8.guide.after:
Guide: Eight badges! The League will
have to let you in now. If there is a League.
c10.g8.board:
"A feeds relays 1 and 2. B feeds 2 and 3.
C feeds 1 and 3. Two feeds cancel out."
c10.g8.gate:
The lift gate. It opens when the summit
lift gets power on relays 1 and 3, not 2.
c10.g8.turbine.on: Turbine {t}. It's humming at full speed.
c10.g8.turbine.running:
The turbines are humming. The lift is
running. Best not touch anything now.
c10.g8.overload:
Relay 2 sparks and spits. Overload!
The lift stays dark.
c10.g8.lift.on:
Relays 1 and 3 hum; 2 is quiet. Far above,
the summit lift jerks awake. The gate opens!
c10.g8.relay2.on: Relay 2: live. The lift can't take it.
c10.g8.t1.intro:
Technician: Visitors aren't allowed in the hall.
Challengers are worse.
c10.g8.t1.lose:
Technician: Turbine A feeds 1 and 2.
Not that I told you.
c10.g8.t2.intro:
Technician: The Chief says nobody touches
the turbines. So I'll touch you instead.
c10.g8.t2.lose:
Technician: Ow. Two feeds on one relay
cancel out. Physics, not me.
c10.g8.t3.intro:
Technician: Our numbers don't add up.
Neither will your chances.
c10.g8.t3.lose:
Technician: ...Our numbers really don't add up.
Ask the Chief why. She won't say.
c10.as.1:
Astrid: You're the one from the radio.
I'm the one who keeps the lights on.
c10.as.2:
Astrid: I've done my sums a hundred times.
Battle me. I need to think about something else.
c10.as.win: Astrid: Not yet. Charge up and come back.
c10.as.lose:
Astrid: ...Good. That was the cleanest
current I've felt in months.
c10.as.gears:
Astrid: These are for your bike. High-torque
gears. Enough to climb a ski slope in a storm.
c10.as.data.1:
Astrid: And this. Please take this.
The Grid's real output. Every day.
c10.as.data.2:
Astrid: It's three times what every turbine
in Hafnia could make. It's not ours to make.
c10.as.data.3:
Astrid: I have a daughter. She's seven.
Please get this to someone.
c10.as.data.4:
Astrid: The summit lift has power now.
When the time comes, it'll take you up.
c10.as.after:
Astrid: Go. Before I lose my nerve
and ask for it back.
c10.ch.screens:
Every screen on Amager flickers at once.
Director Lindholm, smiling.
c10.ch.lindholm.1:
Lindholm: Tonight the Bifrost Reactor runs at
120%. A gift to the League Championship.
c10.ch.lindholm.2:
Lindholm: Free power for every home in Hafnia.
You're welcome, Copenhagen.
c10.ch.brix.1:
Your phone buzzes. Brix: "120%?!
That fool. It'll break."
c10.ch.brix.2:
Brix: "And when it breaks, the singing
stops for good. Find Ørsted. Now."
c10.end:
Your save is kept. The story continues in
Chapter 11: The Rising Tide.
